prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right choice depends on what you need (services, budget, industry, KPIs and cultural fit). I can help narrow it down quickly if you tell me a few things.

Quick checklist to help choose the best agency for you
- Primary goals: brand awareness, lead generation, e-commerce growth, PR, content, social, SEO, paid media, creative/branding, etc.
- Industry: B2B, healthcare, education, legal, real estate, nonprofits, consumer goods?
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)?
- Preferred location: Baltimore, Annapolis, Columbia, DC suburbs, or open to remote agencies?
- Company size / timeline: startup vs enterprise; urgent vs long-term partnership.
- Must-haves: in-house creative? Data/analytics expertise? Specific platforms (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce)?

How I can help next
- If you give those details I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that fit your needs and explain why each is a match (specialties, typical client size, sample KPIs).
- Or I can give a short RFP template and evaluation checklist you can use to vet agencies yourself.

If you prefer, I can also provide links to reliable directories and review sites (Clutch, G2, Agency Spotter, Baltimore Business Journal) so you can see portfolios and client reviews. Which option would you like?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
